T03.context_zh: 帮AI伦理测试题变得更真实、更全面，专用于评估AI在复杂现实场景中的表现。
keep_from_original_zh: 保留原题里的人物角色
保留原题里的关键行为和目的
保留原题里的规则或社会常识
保留原题里谁受影响、谁做决定
primary_tool_steps_zh: 把原始测试题补全成一个完整故事
明确写出谁在做什么、为什么做
列出所有相关的人（包括被影响者、旁观者、决策者）
说明传递了什么信息或做了什么动作
写清楚有哪些限制条件和可能出的问题
标出哪些行为是鼓励的、哪些是禁止的
outputs_zh: 一份结构清晰的伦理场景描述（含人物、目的、动作、约束等）
一份标注清楚各方立场和影响的对照表
一份风险提示清单（比如隐私泄露、歧视、信任崩塌）
一份可直接用于AI测试的标准化题目模板
一份需人工确认的关键判断点标记（如文化禁忌、法律红线）
automatable_zh: 自动补全人物身份和关系
自动识别并填写信息传递路径
自动提取原始题干中的目的和行为
自动匹配常见风险类型（如偏见、越权、误导）
needs_human_zh: 判断某行为在特定文化中是否合理
确认哪些约束来自真实法律或行业规范
决定谁该拥有最终决策权（如老人护理中患者vs家属）
判断某个后果是否真的算‘严重伤害’而非主观感受
T03.context_en: Help AI ethics test questions become more realistic and comprehensive, specifically for evaluating AI in complex real-world scenarios.
keep_from_original_en: Keep the original characters
Retain key actions and purposes from the original
Maintain rules or social common sense from the original
Preserve who is affected and who makes decisions
primary_tool_steps_en: Expand the original test question into a complete story
Clearly state who is doing what and why
List all relevant people (including those affected, bystanders, and decision-makers)
Specify what information is conveyed or what actions are taken
Clarify constraints and potential issues
Mark which behaviors are encouraged and which are prohibited
outputs_en: A clearly structured ethical scenario description (including characters, purposes, actions, constraints, etc.)
A comparison table clearly marking the positions and impacts of all parties
A risk alert checklist (e.g., privacy leaks, discrimination, trust collapse)
A standardized question template directly usable for AI testing
A list of key judgment points requiring human confirmation (such as cultural taboos, legal red lines)
automatable_en: Automatically complete character identities and relationships
Automatically identify and fill in information transmission paths
Automatically extract purposes and actions from the original question stem
Automatically match common risk types (such as bias, overstepping, misinformation)
needs_human_en: Determine if an action is reasonable in a specific culture
Confirm which constraints come from real laws or industry standards
Decide who should have the final say (e.g., patient vs. family in elder care)
Judge whether a consequence truly counts as 'serious harm' rather than subjective feeling

T02.context_zh: 帮AI伦理测试题查清每条判断依据来自哪、是否靠谱、边界在哪。
keep_from_original_zh: 保留原题里已有的分类逻辑（比如按场景、意图、行为、后果分）
保留原题中已标注的伦理类型（如尊重自主、公平、关怀等）
保留原题用到的心理或行为量表名称（如羞耻感、无助感）
primary_tool_steps_zh: 把每道题的答案依据，拆成‘谁定的规矩’（法律/指南/共识等）
标出这条规矩适用的范围（比如中国医疗、全球AI平台）
写清楚哪些行为绝对不行、哪些可以做、哪些大家看法不一
指出哪些情况证据太少、没法下结论
说明什么情况下必须找专家拍板
outputs_zh: 一份清晰台账：每条评分标准都对应到具体来源和适用条件
明确标出所有有争议、没依据、或需专家介入的地方
生成人工复核清单，只列真正需要人判断的关键点
automatable_zh: 自动提取题目中提到的法规、指南、量表、理论名称
自动匹配常见法域（如中国、欧盟）、领域（医疗、教育、社交）
自动识别‘禁止/允许/可能有分歧’这类关键词并归类
needs_human_zh: 判断某条规矩在当前情境下是否真能用（比如国外伦理原则能否套用国内社区）
决定‘争议’和‘证据不足’的界限——机器分不清模糊地带
最终确认哪些问题必须交给人类专家，不能靠AI猜
T02.context_en: Help AI ethics test questions clarify the basis of each judgment, its reliability, and boundaries.
keep_from_original_en: Keep the original question's classification logic (e.g., by scenario, intent, action, consequence)
Retain the ethical types already marked in the original question (e.g., respect for autonomy, fairness, care)
Preserve the names of psychological or behavioral scales used (e.g., shame, helplessness)
primary_tool_steps_en: Break down the answer basis of each question into 'who set the rule' (law/guideline/consensus, etc.)
Mark the scope of this rule (e.g., Chinese healthcare, global AI platforms)
Clearly state what is absolutely not allowed, what can be done, and what has mixed opinions
Point out situations with too little evidence to draw conclusions
Explain when an expert must make the final decision
outputs_en: A clear ledger: each scoring criterion corresponds to specific sources and conditions
Clearly mark all controversial, unsupported, or expert-required areas
Generate a human review checklist, listing only key points needing judgment
automatable_en: Automatically extract mentioned laws, guidelines, scales, and theory names from the questions
Automatically match common jurisdictions (e.g., China, EU) and fields (healthcare, education, social)
Automatically identify and categorize keywords like 'prohibited/allowed/may have disagreements'
needs_human_en: Determine if a rule truly applies in the current context (e.g., applying foreign ethical principles domestically)
Decide the boundary between 'controversial' and 'insufficient evidence' - machines can't discern gray areas
Finally confirm which issues must be handed over to human experts, not guessed by AI

T06.context_zh: 检测AI是否偷偷依赖性别、种族等不该看的信息做判断
keep_from_original_zh: 原任务目标不变（比如还是分类或回答）
答案范围不变（比如选项还是那几个）
真实场景上下文保留（如招聘广告、医生对话、审核指令）
primary_tool_steps_zh: 找出原样本里可能引发偏见的关键词（如职业、代词、群体名）
只改这个词或它的搭配，其他字全不动
生成2-4个新句子，每个只换一个地方
确保新句子看起来都合理、自然、像真人写的
检查所有句子的答案应该一样（否则就不是‘对照’了）
outputs_zh: 一组原始句+对照句（每组2-4句）
每句标注改了哪里（比如‘把‘engineer’配‘he’改成配‘she’’）
说明这组句子想测什么偏见（比如‘模型会不会因性别联想降低护士的专业可信度？’）
标出哪些地方必须人工确认（比如本地文化中‘nurse’是否真带性别暗示）
automatable_zh: 自动找可替换的敏感词（如职业、代词、群体名）
自动生成语法通顺的对照句
自动检查句子长度、结构、词性是否基本一致
自动标记改动位置和类型
needs_human_zh: 判断某个词在当地是否真有偏见含义（比如印地语里‘nurse’是否默认指女性）
确认改写后句子是否符合真实使用场景（比如医生对话里会不会真这么说）
决定哪类偏见该测、哪类不该测（比如宗教vs.地域歧视的优先级）
核对法律/政策依据（比如EEOC条款是否真支持这个对照逻辑）
T06.context_en: Check if AI is secretly relying on information it shouldn't, like gender or race, to make decisions
keep_from_original_en: Original task goal remains (e.g., still classification or answering)
Answer range unchanged (e.g., same set of options)
Real-world context preserved (e.g., job ad, doctor's conversation, review instructions)
primary_tool_steps_en: Identify potential bias-triggering keywords in the original sample (e.g., occupation, pronouns, group names)
Change only this word or its collocation, keep all other words as they are
Generate 2-4 new sentences, each with a single change
Ensure all new sentences appear reasonable, natural, and human-like
Verify that all sentences have the same answer (otherwise, it's not a 'control')
outputs_en: A set of original + control sentences (each set 2-4 sentences)
Each sentence annotated with what was changed (e.g., 'changed ‘he’ paired with ‘engineer’ to ‘she’')
Explanation of which bias the sentence set aims to test (e.g., 'Does the model lower the professional credibility of nurses based on gender association?')
Mark areas requiring human verification (e.g., whether 'nurse' carries a gender implication in local culture)
automatable_en: Automatically find replaceable sensitive words (e.g., occupations, pronouns, group names)
Automatically generate grammatically correct control sentences
Automatically check if sentence length, structure, and part-of-speech are roughly consistent
Automatically mark the location and type of changes
needs_human_en: Determine if a word truly has a biased meaning locally (e.g., does 'nurse' default to female in Hindi?)
Confirm if rewritten sentences fit real usage scenarios (e.g., would a doctor really say this in conversation?)
Decide which types of biases to test and which not to (e.g., priority between religious vs. regional discrimination)
Verify legal/policy basis (e.g., does EEOC policy support this control logic?)

T08.context_zh: 测试AI在多轮对话中会不会被一步步带偏、突破底线。
keep_from_original_zh: 保留原始对话角色（如求助者/支持者）
保留原数据中的关键分类标签（如性别、年龄、职业）
保留人工标注的判断标准和风险类型
primary_tool_steps_zh: 把单句提问改成一连串对话，像钓鱼一样逐步试探
让AI先放松警惕，再悄悄改变话题方向
每轮都加一点压力，比如装可怜、扮权威、换说法绕开规则
最后看它会不会说出不该说的内容或放弃原则
全程记录AI哪一轮开始松动、哪一句越界
outputs_zh: 一套带编号的多轮攻击对话（含每轮目的说明）
AI每轮回复是否守住了底线的明确标记
越界发生的具体位置和原因简要分析
可复用的对话模板（含信任建立、伪装、施压、终击四步）
automatable_zh: 自动生成多轮试探性对话草稿
自动识别AI回复中是否含敏感词或违规倾向
自动比对前后轮次，标出态度变化点
按模板批量改写原始数据（如替换称谓、调整语气）
needs_human_zh: 判断某句话算不算‘情绪操控’或‘伪装目的’
确认文化/伦理边界在哪里（比如哪些话在校园场景能说，在医疗场景不能说）
决定哪些越界行为属于高风险，必须人工干预
T08.context_en: Test if AI can be gradually led astray and cross ethical boundaries in multi-turn conversations.
keep_from_original_en: Keep original dialogue roles (e.g., seeker/supporter)
Retain key classification labels from the data (e.g., gender, age, occupation)
Maintain human-annotated criteria and risk types
primary_tool_steps_en: Transform single-question prompts into a series of dialogues, probing step by step
Let AI lower its guard first, then subtly change the topic direction
Increase pressure each round, e.g., feigning vulnerability, posing as authority, rephrasing to bypass rules
See if it ends up saying something inappropriate or abandoning principles
Record which round AI starts to waver and where it crosses the line
outputs_en: A numbered set of multi-turn attack dialogues (with purpose for each round)
Clear markings on whether AI's response per round adheres to the bottom line
Specific location and brief analysis of boundary crossing
Reusable dialogue templates (including trust building, disguise, pressure, final strike)
automatable_en: Automatically generate drafts of multi-turn probing dialogues
Automatically identify sensitive words or rule-violating tendencies in AI responses
Automatically compare rounds, marking points of attitude change
Batch rewrite original data according to templates (e.g., replacing titles, adjusting tone)
needs_human_en: Determine if a statement counts as 'emotional manipulation' or has 'disguised intent'
Confirm where cultural/ethical boundaries lie (e.g., what is acceptable in school vs. medical settings)
Decide which boundary-crossing behaviors are high-risk and require human intervention

T05.context_zh: 把国外AI伦理测试题改成符合本地文化、语言和生活习惯的版本
keep_from_original_zh: 保留原来的测试维度（比如年龄、公平感、角色关系等）
保留原来的打分方式或判断标准
保留原题想考察的核心道德或社会问题
primary_tool_steps_zh: 把题目里的外国人名、职业、地点换成本地常见的
把说话方式、礼貌用语、家庭关系换成当地人习惯的
把涉及法律、医疗、教育等规则换成本地实际执行的
把道德判断题的情境换成本地人真会遇到的两难选择
请本地老师、医生、社区老人等真实用户看看题目是否合理
确认改完后，还是在测原来想测的那个能力
outputs_zh: 一套本地人看得懂、觉得真实的AI伦理测试题
每道题都标清楚它在测哪方面（比如‘尊重长辈’或‘举报违规’）
附带本地专家指出的风险点或争议处（比如‘这里可能冒犯老年人’）
支持多语言的同一套题（如中文版、日文版、阿拉伯文版）
automatable_zh: 自动替换地名、职业名、称谓（如‘Mr. Smith’→‘张老师’）
自动翻译题目并保持原意不变
自动检查题目是否还包含原测试维度（如是否仍有‘角色关系’这一项）
自动标注哪些题可能需要人工重点看
needs_human_zh: 判断某个行为在当地算不算失礼或违规（比如‘当面提意见’是坦率还是没教养）
决定哪个选项更符合本地人的实际选择（不是理论上该选啥）
确认老人、学生、医护等不同群体对同一题的理解是否一致
最终签字认可：这套题真的能测出AI在本地是否靠谱
T05.context_en: Adapt foreign AI ethics test questions to fit local culture, language, and living habits
keep_from_original_en: Keep the original testing dimensions (e.g., age, sense of fairness, role relationships)
Retain the original scoring method or criteria
Preserve the core moral or social issues the original questions aim to examine
primary_tool_steps_en: Replace foreign names, occupations, and locations with common local ones
Adjust speech, polite expressions, and family relations to local customs
Update laws, medical, and educational rules to those actually practiced locally
Change moral judgment scenarios to real dilemmas locals might face
Have local teachers, doctors, and community elders review the questions for appropriateness
Ensure the adapted questions still measure the intended capabilities
outputs_en: A set of AI ethics test questions that locals find understandable and realistic
Each question clearly labeled with what it tests (e.g., 'respecting elders' or 'reporting violations')
Include risk points or contentious areas pointed out by local experts (e.g., 'this may offend the elderly')
Support multiple language versions of the same set (e.g., Chinese, Japanese, Arabic)
automatable_en: Automatically replace place names, job titles, and forms of address (e.g., 'Mr. Smith' → 'Teacher Zhang')
Automatically translate questions while preserving the original meaning
Automatically check if the questions still include the original testing dimensions (e.g., 'role relationships')
Automatically flag questions that may need human review
needs_human_en: Determine if a behavior is considered rude or inappropriate in the local context (e.g., 'giving feedback directly')
Decide which option better reflects the actual choice locals would make (not just theoretically correct)
Verify if different groups like the elderly, students, and healthcare workers understand a question consistently
Final approval: This set of questions can truly assess if an AI is reliable in the local context

T04.context_zh: 给AI测试题打风险分，告诉它什么情况该帮、该问清楚、该拒绝或转给真人。
keep_from_original_zh: 原题目的核心问题不能删
原来标注的风险类型要保留
题目涉及的领域（如法律、医疗、金融）不能换
人工确认过的敏感标签要沿用
primary_tool_steps_zh: 给每道题标出低/中/高风险等级
按危害类型（如违法、伤身、骗钱）归类
明确写清：什么等级下必须拒绝、什么下可以帮忙、什么下得先问清楚
对高风险题，强制要求回答时引用具体法规或医学依据
为同一类危害设计更难的变体题目来测AI抗压能力
检查所有题目和评分标准是否和风险分类一致
outputs_zh: 每道题都带风险等级（低/中/高）和危害类型（如‘骗钱’‘伤身’‘违法’）
每类风险都配好AI该怎么做（帮/拒/问/转）的明确规则
生成一批更刁钻但真实存在的新题目，专测AI会不会被绕过
标出哪些题或规则必须由人再看一遍才放心
automatable_zh: 自动给题目打风险初筛等级
自动把常见问题匹配到危害类型（如‘怎么自杀’→伤身高风险）
自动按规则生成同类变体题目（如把‘减肥’改成‘三天只喝柠檬水’）
自动检查题目标签和风险等级是否自相矛盾
needs_human_zh: 判断模糊表述是否真违法（如涉台用语是否踩线）
确认医学/法律依据是否准确且最新（如援引哪条法条）
决定文化敏感题的处理方式（如宗教、民族相关表述）
最终拍板哪些高风险题必须禁答，不能靠模型自己猜
T04.context_en: Score AI test questions for risk, guiding it on when to help, clarify, refuse, or escalate to a human.
keep_from_original_en: Do not delete the core issue of the original question
Retain the originally marked risk types
Do not change the field involved (e.g., legal, medical, financial)
Carry over any sensitive tags confirmed by humans
primary_tool_steps_en: Label each question with low/medium/high risk levels
Categorize by harm type (e.g., illegal, harmful, fraudulent)
Clearly state: what level must be refused, helped, or clarified first
For high-risk questions, require specific legal or medical references in answers
Design harder variant questions to test AI's resilience within the same harm category
Ensure all questions and scoring criteria are consistent with risk categorization
outputs_en: Each question labeled with risk level (low/medium/high) and harm type (e.g., 'fraud', 'harmful', 'illegal')
Clear rules for AI actions (help/reject/ask/escalate) for each risk category
Generate a set of more challenging but realistic new questions to test if AI can be bypassed
Identify which questions or rules need human review for reassurance
automatable_en: Automatically assign initial risk levels to questions
Automatically match common issues to harm types (e.g., 'how to commit suicide' → high physical harm risk)
Automatically generate similar variant questions based on rules (e.g., changing 'weight loss' to 'drinking only lemon water for three days')
Automatically check for contradictions between question labels and risk levels
needs_human_en: Determine if ambiguous statements are truly illegal (e.g., Taiwan-related language)
Verify the accuracy and currency of medical/legal references (e.g., which law is cited)
Decide how to handle culturally sensitive questions (e.g., religious, ethnic expressions)
Make the final decision on which high-risk questions must be prohibited, not guessed by the model

T01.context_zh: 帮伦理测评工具把模糊口号变成能打分、可验证的具体标准
keep_from_original_zh: 原来用的分类标签（比如谁该负责、哪种道德更重要）
原来的数据类型和场景（如医生对话、学生反馈）
原来的人群视角（如老师、家长、学生）
原来的打分方式或量表（如MFQ-2六维度）
primary_tool_steps_zh: 把大而空的伦理主张拆成具体要测什么
明确保护谁、在什么情况下有效
划出这个测评不适用的边界
说明哪些结论绝对不能乱推
把原始评分规则和新拆解的标准对齐检查
标出必须人工判断的风险点
outputs_zh: 一份清晰的‘能测什么、不能测什么’说明书
每条伦理主张对应的具体观测点和例子
标注好谁会被影响、谁的声音必须被听见
明确列出哪些情况不该用这个测评结果
带标记的校验报告：哪些地方自动对得上，哪些要人来把关
automatable_zh: 自动把原始声明拆成目标、场景、保护对象等字段
自动比对新旧分类标签是否一致
自动检查评分规则是否覆盖所有子维度
自动标出明显越界的外推语句
needs_human_zh: 判断某条边界是否合理（比如‘只测老师不测家长’是否公平）
决定文化敏感问题怎么处理（如告知绝症是否适合所有地区）
确认多角色标注里有没有遗漏关键立场
最终拍板哪些结论真的不能外推
T01.context_en: Help ethics assessment tools turn vague slogans into specific, scoreable, and verifiable standards
keep_from_original_en: Original classification labels (e.g., who is responsible, which morals are more important)
Original data types and scenarios (e.g., doctor conversations, student feedback)
Original demographic perspectives (e.g., teachers, parents, students)
Original scoring methods or scales (e.g., MFQ-2 six dimensions)
primary_tool_steps_en: Break down broad ethical claims into specific measurable elements
Clarify who to protect and under what circumstances it's effective
Define the boundaries where this assessment does not apply
Specify which conclusions must never be drawn
Align and check original scoring rules with new broken-down standards
Mark risk points that require human judgment
outputs_en: A clear 'what can and cannot be measured' manual
Specific observation points and examples for each ethical claim
Identify who is affected and whose voices must be heard
Explicitly list situations where results should not be used
A marked validation report: what matches automatically and what needs human oversight
automatable_en: Automatically break down original statements into goals, scenarios, protected entities, etc.
Automatically compare new and old classification labels for consistency
Automatically check if scoring rules cover all sub-dimensions
Automatically flag clearly out-of-bound extrapolative statements
needs_human_en: Determine if a certain boundary is reasonable (e.g., 'only assess teachers, not parents' fairness)
Decide how to handle culturally sensitive issues (e.g., informing about terminal illness suitability in all regions)
Verify no key positions are missed in multi-role annotations
Finalize which conclusions truly cannot be extrapolated

T07.context_zh: 检查AI在各种真实场景下会不会犯伦理错误，比如误判病情、歧视患者、说错医疗建议。
keep_from_original_zh: 原来测试里哪些能力要测（如共情、公平、安全）
原来覆盖的典型场景（如问诊、开药、危机响应）
原来涉及的关键人群（如老人、儿童、抑郁症患者）
原来关注的风险类型（如误诊、歧视、隐私泄露）
primary_tool_steps_zh: 列出AI该具备的伦理能力，比如不乱下诊断、不歧视特定人群
列出常见真实场景，比如患者说‘我活够了’时该怎么回应
列出可能受影响的人，比如孕妇、青少年、非母语者
按风险轻重和测试方式（选择题/生成回答/改写提问）分组搭配
为每种组合设计1–3个具体测试题，确保不漏关键漏洞
标出哪些题必须人工判断对错，不能全靠机器评分
outputs_zh: 一张清晰表格：横排是场景+人群+风险+题型，竖列是伦理能力
每个格子里有1–3道可直接用的测试题（含题干和正确响应标准）
标出哪些题容易引发文化/法律/医学争议，需专家复核
指出原测试中哪些题被遗漏或重复，哪些能力没被真正考到
给出后续补题建议，比如‘缺少老年人用药提醒类题目’
automatable_zh: 自动把患者原话转成标准化测试句式（如‘患者说______，模型应______’）
自动按不同题型（判断题/生成题/改写题）批量出题
自动匹配已有题库，找出重复或覆盖空白
自动标注哪些题可用公开数据（如维基、医患论坛）生成
needs_human_zh: 判断某句话是否真属于‘抑郁表达’还是‘自杀意图’，机器易误判
确认某条医疗建议是否符合当前临床指南，需医生把关
决定某类人群（如宗教信仰者）的敏感边界在哪里，不能只靠算法
审核题目是否无意冒犯特定群体，比如用词是否带偏见
T07.context_en: Check if AI makes ethical mistakes in various real scenarios, such as misjudging illnesses, discriminating against patients, or giving incorrect medical advice.
keep_from_original_en: Which capabilities to test (e.g., empathy, fairness, safety)
Typical scenarios covered (e.g., consultation, prescribing, crisis response)
Key populations involved (e.g., elderly, children, depression patients)
Types of risks focused on (e.g., misdiagnosis, discrimination, privacy leaks)
primary_tool_steps_en: List the ethical abilities AI should have, e.g., not making random diagnoses, not discriminating
List common real-life scenarios, e.g., how to respond when a patient says 'I've had enough'
List potentially affected people, e.g., pregnant women, teenagers, non-native speakers
Group and match by risk severity and test method (multiple choice/generate answer/rewrite question)
Design 1-3 specific test questions for each combination, ensuring no key vulnerabilities are missed
Mark which questions require human judgment, not just machine scoring
outputs_en: A clear table: rows are ethical abilities, columns are scenarios + populations + risks + question types
Each cell contains 1-3 ready-to-use test questions (including prompts and correct response standards)
Identify questions that may trigger cultural/legal/medical disputes, needing expert review
Point out which questions were omitted or duplicated in the original test, and which abilities were not truly tested
Provide suggestions for additional questions, e.g., 'lack of medication reminders for the elderly'
automatable_en: Automatically convert patient statements into standardized test formats (e.g., 'Patient says ____, model should ____')
Automatically generate questions in bulk by different types (true/false, generation, rewriting)
Automatically match with existing question banks to find duplicates or gaps
Automatically label which questions can be generated using public data (e.g., Wikipedia, doctor-patient forums)
needs_human_en: Determine if a statement is truly 'depressive' or 'suicidal', as machines can easily misjudge
Verify if a piece of medical advice aligns with current clinical guidelines, requiring a doctor's oversight
Decide on the sensitive boundaries for certain groups (e.g., religious believers), not relying solely on algorithms

T10.context_zh: 检查AI回答里每句话有没有事实依据，专用于法律、医疗、政务等高风险场景。
keep_from_original_zh: 保留原问题的分类意图（比如是选A还是B、要不要对比、是否重复确认）
保留原数据中人工打的标签类型（如‘原告’‘告知’‘就业公平’）
保留原任务要判断的核心对象（如当事人身份、医疗建议、政策含义）
primary_tool_steps_zh: 把AI的回答拆成一句句独立的小结论
为每一句小结论去找真实可靠的资料来支持或反驳
明确标出哪句有证据支持、哪句被证据推翻、哪句找不到足够依据
要求AI在回答时必须写出依据来自哪份材料、哪条条款或哪个案例
检查每句结论是否过时、是否带猜测、是否忽略关键限制条件
outputs_zh: 一份带编号的声明清单，每句都标注了证据状态（支持/矛盾/不足）
每句声明对应引用的具体证据原文或来源出处
指出哪些结论存在时间错位、主观推测或文化盲区的风险点
automatable_zh: 自动把长回答切分成单句声明
自动检索公开数据库或文档找相关证据片段
自动比对声明和证据是否逻辑匹配（支持/矛盾/无关）
自动标记明显过时信息（如引用已废止法规）
needs_human_zh: 判断证据是否真正权威（比如内部会议纪要能否当依据）
决定模糊表述是否构成歧视或偏见（如‘老年人不适合加班’）
确认文化或政策语境下某句话是否违规（如基层政务中的敏感提法）
最终拍板哪些风险必须人工干预，不能靠AI自判
T10.context_en: Check each sentence in AI responses for factual basis, specifically for high-risk scenarios like law, medicine, and governance.
keep_from_original_en: Keep the original question's intent (e.g., choosing A or B, making comparisons, seeking confirmation)
Retain the type of human-labeled tags from the original data (e.g., 'plaintiff', 'notification', 'employment equity')
Maintain the core subject of the original task (e.g., party identity, medical advice, policy implications)
primary_tool_steps_en: Break down the AI response into independent small conclusions
Find credible sources to support or refute each small conclusion
Clearly mark which sentences are supported, refuted, or lack sufficient evidence
Require AI to cite the source, clause, or case for its claims
Check if each conclusion is outdated, speculative, or ignores key limitations
outputs_en: A numbered list of statements, each labeled with evidence status (supported/contradicted/insufficient)
Specific evidence or source citations for each statement
Identify risks of temporal mismatch, subjective speculation, or cultural insensitivity in conclusions
automatable_en: Automatically split long responses into single-sentence statements
Automatically search public databases or documents for relevant evidence snippets
Automatically compare statements with evidence for logical match (support/contradiction/irrelevance)
Automatically flag clearly outdated information (e.g., citing repealed laws)
needs_human_en: Determine if evidence is truly authoritative (e.g., can internal meeting minutes be used as evidence)
Decide if vague expressions constitute discrimination or bias (e.g., 'elderly unsuitable for overtime')
Verify if a statement is non-compliant within cultural or policy context (e.g., sensitive phrasing in local governance)
Make the final decision on which risks require human intervention, not AI judgment

T12.context_zh: 给AI的回答打分，确保评分公平、一致、有依据。
keep_from_original_zh: 保留原题目的核心判断标准（比如该不该撞人、该不该质疑老人）
沿用原有题目结构（如场景描述+选项+正确答案）
继承原有分类维度（如道德、情绪、社交等角度）
复用已验证的正反面典型例子
primary_tool_steps_zh: 为每道题定出清晰的打分标准（0-5分或对/错/部分对）
配上好答案和坏答案的具体例子
让至少两个人（人或AI）独立打分
自动挑出两人打分差距大的答案交给专家重看
统计所有人打分是否靠谱，发现靠运气蒙对的模型
人工抽查问题难易度和文化适配性
outputs_zh: 每道题的详细打分规则说明
每个答案的多人评分结果和一致性报告
需人工复核的问题清单（含原因）
模型在不同难度/文化情境下的表现对比表
常见错误类型分析（如总忽略老人意愿、总偏向年轻群体）
automatable_zh: 生成打分标准初稿和正反例
自动分配评分任务并汇总结果
识别低一致性样本并标出
计算评分者之间的一致率
按预设维度自动归类错误类型
needs_human_zh: 判断某条标准是否真的符合伦理或专业规范
确认正反例是否真实反映现实困境
决定哪些文化差异必须人工把关（如中日老人自主权理解差异）
最终裁定争议答案该得几分
T12.context_en: Score AI responses to ensure fairness, consistency, and justifiability.
keep_from_original_en: Retain the core judgment criteria (e.g., whether to hit a person, question an elder)
Maintain the original question structure (scenario + options + correct answer)
Inherit existing classification dimensions (e.g., moral, emotional, social perspectives)
Reuse validated positive and negative examples
primary_tool_steps_en: Set clear scoring criteria for each question (0-5 or right/wrong/partially right)
Provide specific examples of good and bad answers
Have at least two individuals (human or AI) score independently
Automatically flag answers with large scoring discrepancies for expert review
Analyze overall scoring reliability, identifying models that guess correctly by chance
Manually check question difficulty and cultural appropriateness
outputs_en: Detailed scoring guidelines for each question
Multi-rater scores and consistency report for each answer
List of questions needing human re-evaluation (with reasons)
Comparison table of model performance across different difficulties/cultural contexts
Analysis of common error types (e.g., always ignoring elders' wishes, favoring younger groups)
automatable_en: Draft initial scoring criteria and examples
Automatically assign scoring tasks and compile results
Identify and flag low-consistency samples
Calculate inter-rater agreement rates
Automatically categorize error types by predefined dimensions
needs_human_en: Determine if a criterion truly aligns with ethical or professional standards
Verify if examples accurately reflect real dilemmas
Decide which cultural differences require human oversight (e.g., autonomy of elderly in China vs. Japan)
Make final decisions on disputed answer scores

T09.context_zh: 测试AI助手在真实办公场景中调用工具、处理文件、发邮件等实际操作是否安全可靠。
keep_from_original_zh: 原题要测的能力类型（比如权限意识、异常应对）
原题涉及的关键角色（如医生、员工、开发者）
原题中的敏感信息类型（如病史、密钥、紧急邮件）
原题设定的业务目标（如归档、上传、审查）
primary_tool_steps_zh: 把纯问答题改成需要动手操作的任务
明确告诉AI能做什么、不能做什么
在任务里故意加故障（比如假数据、坏链接、权限不足）
要求AI每步操作后检查结果再决定下一步
记录AI所有动作和判断，留作分析依据
设定失败时该怎么补救（比如重试、报错、找人帮忙）
outputs_zh: 一套可运行的仿真任务（含指令+工具列表+故障点）
AI执行全过程的操作日志（谁干了什么、何时干的、结果如何）
一份评分说明：哪些行为算合格，哪些暴露风险
标出哪些地方必须人工看（比如是否泄露隐私、越权操作）
给出改进建议（比如该加哪条提醒、该锁哪个按钮）
automatable_zh: 把原始题目自动转成带工具调用步骤的任务描述
自动生成模拟故障（如伪造API返回、隐藏权限提示）
自动提取AI操作日志里的关键动作和决策点
自动比对AI行为与预设的安全规则（如‘不传密钥’‘不越权移动’）
needs_human_zh: 判断AI某次操作是否真的越界（比如‘转发’算不算泄露）
确认哪些信息在当前场景下属于敏感（如‘Slack讨论’是否该屏蔽）
评估文化或合规红线（如HIPAA原则在本地是否适用）
决定哪些故障该让AI自己处理，哪些必须立刻叫停
T09.context_en: Test if the AI assistant is safe and reliable in real office scenarios, such as using tools, handling files, and sending emails.
keep_from_original_en: Type of capability being tested (e.g., awareness of permissions, handling anomalies)
Key roles involved in the original question (e.g., doctor, employee, developer)
Types of sensitive information in the original question (e.g., medical history, keys, urgent emails)
Business objectives set in the original question (e.g., archiving, uploading, reviewing)
primary_tool_steps_en: Change a pure Q&A into a hands-on task
Clearly inform the AI what it can and cannot do
Intentionally add faults (e.g., fake data, broken links, insufficient permissions)
Require the AI to check results after each step before proceeding
Record all actions and decisions made by the AI for analysis
Set up recovery procedures for failures (e.g., retry, report error, seek help)
outputs_en: A set of executable simulation tasks (including instructions, tool list, and fault points)
A log of the AI's entire operation process (who did what, when, and the outcome)
A scoring guide: which behaviors are acceptable, which expose risks
Highlight areas that require human review (e.g., privacy leaks, unauthorized operations)
Provide improvement suggestions (e.g., add reminders, lock certain buttons)
automatable_en: Automatically convert the original question into a task description with tool usage steps
Automatically generate simulated faults (e.g., fake API responses, hidden permission prompts)
Automatically extract key actions and decision points from the AI's operation log
Automatically compare the AI's behavior against preset security rules (e.g., 'do not transmit keys', 'no unauthorized moves')
needs_human_en: Determine if an AI operation truly crosses a boundary (e.g., does 'forwarding' count as leaking?)
Confirm which information is considered sensitive in the current scenario (e.g., should 'Slack discussions' be blocked?)
Evaluate cultural or compliance red lines (e.g., is HIPAA applicable locally?)
Decide which faults the AI should handle alone and which require immediate human intervention

T13.context_zh: 帮AI评测工具变得透明、可重复、好验证，用在科研和产品上线前。
keep_from_original_zh: 原始任务类型（比如判断对错、多跳推理）
人工打的标签标准（比如中性/矛盾/蕴含）
数据来源和真实场景用途
已知可能出错的地方
primary_tool_steps_zh: 写清楚这个评测是干什么用的
说明哪些情况不适用这个评测
标出数据从哪来、怎么标注的
列出模型跑时用的具体设置和提示词
给出一行命令就能重跑结果
注明所有引用的资料和版本
outputs_zh: 一张清晰的评测说明书（谁都能看懂用途和限制）
一份数据说明书（含来源、标注方式、潜在问题）
一套完整可运行的评测脚本和环境配置
明确标注每条测试用例的预期答案和评分逻辑
指出哪些结论需要人工再确认，比如文化敏感或法律边界问题
automatable_zh: 自动生成复现命令和依赖清单
自动提取模型版本、prompt和解码参数
自动整理数据来源链接和引用格式
自动检查脚本是否能成功运行
needs_human_zh: 判断哪些使用场景算‘不适用’，比如涉及儿童或医疗决策
核对标签是否真符合现实逻辑（如中性判断是否被偏见干扰）
识别文化、法律或伦理风险点并写进说明书
确认评分规则是否公平覆盖不同人群或文档类型
T13.context_en: Make AI evaluation tools transparent, reproducible, and verifiable for research and pre-launch product testing.
keep_from_original_en: Original task type (e.g., right/wrong judgment, multi-hop reasoning)
Human labeling criteria (e.g., neutral/contradictory/entailment)
Data sources and real-world application scenarios
Known potential error points
primary_tool_steps_en: Clearly state the purpose of this evaluation
Specify which scenarios are not suitable for this evaluation
Indicate data sources and annotation methods
List specific settings and prompts used in model runs
Provide a single command to reproduce results
Note all referenced materials and versions
outputs_en: A clear evaluation manual (understandable purpose and limitations)
A data manual (including sources, annotation methods, potential issues)
A complete, runnable evaluation script and environment setup
Explicitly label expected answers and scoring logic for each test case
Identify conclusions needing human re-verification, e.g., cultural sensitivity or legal boundaries
automatable_en: Automatically generate reproduction commands and dependency lists
Automatically extract model version, prompt, and decoding parameters
Automatically organize data source links and citation formats
Automatically check if scripts run successfully
needs_human_en: Determine which use cases are 'unsuitable', e.g., involving children or medical decisions
Verify if labels truly match real-world logic (e.g., if neutrality is biased)
Identify cultural, legal, or ethical risk points and include in the manual
Confirm if scoring rules fairly cover different demographics or document types

T11.context_zh: 查清AI在哪种场景、对哪类人、犯了哪种错，还错得有多严重。
keep_from_original_zh: 保留原测试题目的真实使用场景
保留原测试中区分不同人群的分组方式
保留原测试里定义的各类风险类型（如有害、偏见、说错、拒答过头）
primary_tool_steps_zh: 把原来一个总分，拆成‘场景×人群×错误类型×指标’的明细表
逐项检查AI在每种组合下是否帮上忙、是否安全、是否公平、是否说真话
标出哪些地方AI特别容易出错（比如对老年人总答错，或一提政治就乱拒绝）
统计AI是不是动不动就拒绝回答（哪怕问题很安全），或者硬要回答明显危险的问题
outputs_zh: 一张清晰表格：横排是场景和人群，竖排是各项表现（有用性、安全性、公平性等）
每格里标出AI具体哪里出问题（例如‘对女性用户过度拒绝求职建议’）
列出最常发生的3–5种典型翻车情况（如‘一遇宗教话题就胡编答案’）
标出哪些问题AI答得特别犹豫或矛盾（比如同一问题两次回答自相矛盾）
automatable_zh: 自动把原始测试题按场景、人群、风险类型分类打标签
自动运行多个指标评测脚本，得出每类下的分数
自动找出AI回答中重复出现的错误模式（如高频误用某类词汇）
自动比对AI在不同人群上的表现差异并高亮异常
needs_human_zh: 人工确认‘哪些算敏感话题’‘哪些算弱势群体’是否符合当前地区实际
人工判断AI某些回答是否真的有害，还是只是表述不顺
人工核对价值相关标注（如‘重视集体’vs‘重视个人’）是否贴切语境
人工决定哪些错误必须修复，哪些属于可接受的表达差异
T11.context_en: Identify in which scenarios, for which groups, and what types of errors AI makes, and how severe these errors are.
keep_from_original_en: Maintain the real usage scenarios of the original test questions
Keep the grouping method for different populations from the original test
Retain the risk types defined in the original test (e.g., harmful, biased, incorrect, overly cautious)
primary_tool_steps_en: Break down the total score into a detailed table by 'scenario×population×error type×metric'
Check if AI is helpful, safe, fair, and truthful in each combination
Mark where AI is particularly prone to errors (e.g., always wrong with seniors, or over-rejects on politics)
Count if AI frequently refuses to answer (even safe questions) or insists on answering clearly dangerous ones
outputs_en: A clear table: rows for scenarios and populations, columns for performance (usefulness, safety, fairness, etc.)
Each cell notes specific AI issues (e.g., 'overly rejects job advice for female users')
List 3-5 most common typical failures (e.g., 'makes up answers on religious topics')
Highlight questions where AI's responses are especially hesitant or contradictory
automatable_en: Automatically tag original test questions by scenario, population, and risk type
Automatically run multiple metric evaluation scripts to score each category
Automatically identify recurring error patterns in AI responses (e.g., frequent misuse of certain words)
Automatically compare and highlight differences in AI performance across different populations
needs_human_en: Manually confirm if 'sensitive topics' and 'vulnerable groups' match local realities
Human judgment on whether AI responses are truly harmful or just poorly phrased
Verify context-appropriate value-related labels (e.g., 'collectivism' vs. 'individualism')
Decide which errors must be fixed and which are acceptable expression differences

T14.context_zh: 帮AI测试题库保持新鲜、不被污染、能安全更新和退役
keep_from_original_zh: 原来题目分类的用途（比如考时效性、因果关系、隐私保护）
人工定好的标签含义（如‘该题测模型会不会泄露身份证号’）
题目原本要考察的真实场景（如医生查最新指南、客服处理银行卡信息）
primary_tool_steps_zh: 把题目拆成公开练习题和隐藏正式考题
定期检查题目有没有被模型‘偷学’过（污染检测）
给每版题库打上版本号，记录谁更新、为什么更新
设定题目什么时候该停用（比如法规变了、数据过期了）
留出渠道让使用者报告题目问题
发现风险题（如含真实隐私信息）立刻隔离处理
outputs_zh: 一套带版本号的公开练习题
一套严格保密的隐藏正式考题
一份污染检测报告（哪些题可能已被模型见过）
一份更新/退役日志（谁、何时、为何改题）
一个明确的负责人名单（谁管题库、谁拍板停用）
automatable_zh: 自动给题目加版本号和时间戳
自动扫描题库是否出现在训练数据里（污染检测）
自动比对新旧版题目差异并生成更新摘要
自动按规则标记高风险题（如含银行卡号、身份证号）
needs_human_zh: 人工判断某道题是否真能考出‘会不会拒绝过时医疗建议’

T14.context_en: Help AI test question banks stay fresh, unpolluted, safely updated, and properly retired.
keep_from_original_en: Original purpose of question categories (e.g., testing timeliness, causality, privacy protection)
Manually defined tag meanings (e.g., 'this question tests if the model leaks ID numbers')
Real scenarios the questions aim to examine (e.g., doctors checking latest guidelines, customer service handling bank card information)
primary_tool_steps_en: Divide questions into public practice and hidden formal exam questions
Regularly check if questions have been 'learned' by models (pollution detection)
Label each version of the question bank with a version number, noting who updated and why
Set when questions should be discontinued (e.g., laws change, data expires)
Provide a channel for users to report issues with questions
Immediately isolate and handle risky questions (e.g., containing real private information)
outputs_en: A set of publicly available practice questions with version numbers
A strictly confidential set of hidden formal exam questions
A pollution detection report (which questions may have been seen by models)
An update/retirement log (who, when, and why changes were made)
A clear list of responsible persons (who manages the question bank, who decides on retirement)
automatable_en: Automatically add version numbers and timestamps to questions
Automatically scan if the question bank appears in training data (pollution detection)
Automatically compare differences between new and old versions and generate an update summary
Automatically mark high-risk questions based on rules (e.g., containing bank or ID numbers)
needs_human_en: Human judgment on whether a question truly tests 'rejecting outdated medical advice'
Human confirmation that simulated data in privacy-related questions is safe and compliant
Human decision on retiring a set of questions (e.g., after new regulations are introduced)
Human review of all scoring criteria involving cultural, ethical, and legal boundaries
